name: Snowcaller
body:
There are those among the erqigdlet that learn to channel their mystical connection to the tundra.

Prerequisite(s): Erqigdlet, frozen presence racial trait, must be at least character level 5

Benefit(s): Erqigdlet may use the frozen presence ability to deal damage in a 10 foot burst a number of times per day equal to their character level and the damage of their ray of frost increases to 1d6. They may consume an additional use to do either of the following; increase the range of this ability by +10 feet per character level or increase its damage by +1/2 character level.
